detail: Remove ineffective body-pull task delay and its counterfactual-only regression. New bounded fixed first-chunk size bucket and completed-decode/next-pull boundaries answer whether UTF8 decoding completes before renderer silence or next native IPC pull blocks. Read full original response through same protected transport; preserve split UTF8 and resource cleanup. Add native renderer handle/window visibility flags on failure only, no account/body/exact length. Existing origin restrictions and unchanged deadlines retained; no speculation treated as cause.
